style: Use case: illustration-story. Standalone wide 2:1 horizontal vignette for an offline Chinese cultivation game. Chinese ink wash and pale watercolor, muted celadon green and ochre accents, expressive brushwork, restrained details. Warm ivory rice-paper background #f7f3e8. Generous empty paper above and below; scene concentrated in middle band, fading to paper on ALL FOUR edges. Atmospheric, timeless, no close-up faces. No text, no writing, no calligraphy, no logo, no border, no UI. Keep important elements within central 80 percent. Landscape 1024x512 display.
